_comment: STARTER Tamil keyword set. Deliberately small and conservative -- this is a v0 seed list built from common phishing patterns, not a validated NLP resource. It should be reviewed and expanded by a native Tamil speaker before this signal is trusted at production weight. Matches on Tamil-script substrings; code-mixed EN/TA text (e.g. 'KYC update seiyavum') is handled by running the English matcher on the same string in parallel -- see social_engineering.py.
